Real Windows update from running pilot

Limitations: Tested Windows11 24H2 build26100.9550 only; declared minimum Windows10 build19041 was not exercised.
Sandbox account was administrator with EnableLUA=0; standard-user elevation, UAC consent and cancellation were not exercised.
Network disabled and no DNS adapters; online integrations and functional DNS restore behavior were not exercised here.
Quarantine/remediation retention used harmless inert fixtures. This validates file preservation, not malware handling or restoration of real external system changes.
Windows package uninstall does not execute the custom EXE cleanup path. This run did not apply or prove automatic cleanup of DNS, firewall, hosts or service changes for the MSIX edition.
Guest-only self-signed package was used for sideloading. This is not a production signature or Microsoft Store certification decision.
Log hashes were compared immediately around reset/removal with app stopped. After legitimate app launch, logs were allowed to grow; config, durable marker and inert fixtures remained exact.
